meta.comment: Machine-readable mirror of RESUME.md, conforming to the JSON Resume schema (https://jsonresume.org/schema/). Keep the two in sync: when a role, project, or skill changes in RESUME.md, update it here. Remove any array entry you have no content for rather than leaving placeholder text in place. Service-role dates are year-only because exact months are not known; replace with YYYY-MM when available.

basics.name: Caleb Easton
basics.label: AI-Assisted Development · QA · Technical & Systems Game Design
basics.summary: Game design graduate working in AI-assisted development. Now the only full-time developer on a freight brokerage's in-house CRM. On a live K-12 learning platform, directed more than 430 merged pull requests through Claude Code in under three months and redesigned its AI lesson creator. Brings a game designer's eye for systems and feel to design, triage and QA. Based in Boston; open to on-site in Massachusetts or remote.

work.name: Great Lakes Transport
work.position: Contracted Full-Stack Developer (through Bear Designs LLC)
work.summary: Freight brokerage moving from vendor software to an in-house carrier-relationship CRM on Nuxt / TypeScript / Postgres. Contract through Caleb's single-member LLC, Bear Designs LLC. Stack: Claude Code · GitHub.
highlights: Joined as the only full-time developer on the brokerage's in-house CRM, directing Claude Code sessions on a Nuxt / TypeScript / Postgres codebase.

work.name: ThinkTech
work.summary: Leading ed-tech company behind a PHP / Vue / MySQL K-12 learning platform. Full time 09/2026 to 11/2026, then part-time support. Stack: Claude Code · GitHub · Trello.
highlights: Redesigned the platform's AI lesson creator: a time estimate before generating, a lesson that builds in the background and can be cancelled, and top-up rounds so every lesson has the number of tasks the teacher asked for.
Directed the redesign through 15 pull requests to release behind a feature flag, testing each revision round by hand on the development site.

Directed the fix for wrong answer keys in AI practice sets, so every generated key is checked by an independent second solve: 0 wrong keys in 188 items on the development site, against 16 wrong in an 80-item production sample before.

Directed a Lockdown Browser test flow through 16 pull requests: teachers choose it when assigning, leaving the test starts a countdown instead of an instant lockout, and the browser's Back button asks before locking a student out.

Directed 56 feature cards, 52 of them now on production, including subgroup filtering in lesson reports, AI grading that reads math and drawings, and a choice of summary or full report when sharing results with students.
Triaged the bug backlog and directed more than 430 merged pull requests on about 250 Trello cards, 163 of them bug fixes across the student, teacher, reporting and admin pages.
Directed more than 40 security and access fixes: cross-district data isolation, ownership checks, payment webhook verification and script injection in user-entered text.
Designed the multi-session Claude Code workflow behind this work: an overseer, implementers, AI testers and support.

projects.name: Enemy and Item Scaling
projects.description: Borderlands 2 SDK mod that keeps enemies, loot and missions at the player's level. Designed and playtested by Caleb; the code was written by Claude Code.
highlights: Designed a mod that keeps enemies, loot and missions within a set range of the player's level, as 5 bounds that each work alone or stay vanilla.
Specified each feature for Claude Code, which wrote all of the Python, and directed it through 8 public releases in 3 days.
Playtested in game and found 4 bugs, such as enemies whose loot scaled while their level and health did not.
Redirected mission scaling to raise the mission's own level instead of patching its reward, so the mission log, XP, cash and reward agree.

projects.name: Rattles & Rayguns
projects.description: Arena shooter in which a rattlesnake gunslinger defends a frontier town against waves of alien invaders.
highlights: Built a modular Blueprint weapon system: new guns are children of a base weapon, set by variables, with no per-weapon logic.
Generalized shared behavior into the base Blueprint, such as how a weapon spawns in the player's hands and how many projectiles fire per shot, so new weapons plugged in without changing it.
Owned the weapons system as one of 6 designers alongside 4 artists, on a Full Sail capstone built and released in one month.

projects.name: Weekly Quest Log
projects.description: Gamified personal task system in Google Sheets that resets itself every week. Designed by Caleb; the Apps Script was written by Claude Code.
highlights: Designed a task system as a game progression loop: main quests, side quests and events, with XP from 25 to 100 by effort.
Specified a weekly reset of quests and earned XP on a timed trigger, implemented by Claude Code in Google Apps Script.
